snippet.title: The Flash Video Game: Combat Test
snippet.description:
This is early game footage from the unfinished Flash video game made by Bottlerocket Entertainment in 2008.  When our publisher Brash folded we were about 6 months into full production with about a year still to go on the game so please excuse the roughness of how it looks at this stage.  This video shows a combat arena that we built where we could test out various special moves.  

Combat was built around the Mark of Kri combat system where you could assign a controller button to an opponent and then anytime you pressed that button you would instantly dash to that opponent and strike him. There was a whole combo system integrated and you could use combos on a single opponent or spread the blows out across multiple opponents.  If you watch closely you'll see a variety of Flash's classic moves that we were trying to incorporate.  We still had a long way to go on the game but this should give you a pretty good taste of the direction we were going in.  Enjoy!
